platform.title: Platform Overview
platform.subtitle: Everything you need to make your business smarter and faster

centralized.title: Connect Your Data
centralized.text: Integrate data from ERP, CRM, HRMS, Finance, APIs, cloud platforms, and databases into a unified analytics ecosystem.

process.title: Prepare & Transform
process.text: Clean, validate, enrich, and transform raw data into reliable datasets using powerful ETL and data processing pipelines.

visualize.title: Visualize Business Insights
visualize.text: Create interactive dashboards and monitor key business metrics with powerful visual analytics and executive reporting.

ai.title: AI-Powered Analytics
ai.text: Leverage predictive analytics and machine learning to forecast trends, detect anomalies, and generate intelligent recommendations.

collaborate.title: Collaborate & Automate
collaborate.text: Share reports, schedule automated dashboards, receive real-time alerts, and enable collaboration across teams.

modular.title: Modular Ecosystem
modular.subtitle: Enable your teams with powerful modules that fit your business needs. Precision-engineered components designed for enterprise-scale operations.

dashboard.title: Dashboards
dashboard.text: Gain complete visibility into your enterprise with interactive dashboards, real-time analytics, and AI-powered insights. Monitor key performance indicators, uncover trends, and make faster, data-driven decisions from a single unified platform.

reports.title: Reports
reports.text: Automated PDF and XLS exports for scheduled compliance and performance audits.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: Deep-dive engine for multi-dimensional data exploration and predictive testing. Leverage AI-driven insights to uncover hidden patterns.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.text: Smart notification system with multi-channel routing (Slack, SMS, Email). Never miss a critical threshold breach with intelligent escalation.

userManagement.title: User Management
userManagement.text: Advanced SSO and directory sync for enterprise-scale organization structures. Granular RBAC and audit logging included.

lifecycle.title: The EDABIP Lifecycle
lifecycle.subtitle: From raw data to actionable insights through a precision-engineered process designed for enterprise scale.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.text: Gather high-velocity streams from multiple distributed sources including IoT, CRM, and legacy silos.

processData.title: Process Data
processData.text: Transform raw data into trusted business intelligence with EDABIP's intelligent data preparation engine. Automatically cleanse, validate, normalize, and enrich data from multiple enterprise sources while eliminating inconsistencies and duplicates. Advanced ETL pipelines and real-time processing ensure every dataset is accurate, analytics-ready, and optimized for dashboards, reporting, and AI-powered insights.

aiAnalysis.title: AI Analysis
aiAnalysis.text: Unlock deeper business intelligence with EDABIP's AI-powered analytics engine. Discover hidden patterns, forecast future trends, and detect anomalies using advanced machine learning and predictive models. Turn complex enterprise data into actionable insights that enable faster, smarter, and more confident decision-making.

visualizeInsights.title: Visualize Insights
visualizeInsights.text: Transform complex enterprise data into intuitive, interactive dashboards designed for executive decision-making. Visualize key performance indicators, monitor business trends, and explore data through customizable charts, graphs, and reports.

businessDecisions.title: Business Decisions
businessDecisions.text: Empower teams to make faster, smarter and data-backed decisions.

sovereignty.title: Uncompromising <accent>Data</accent> Sovereignty
sovereignty.description: Secure your enterprise intelligence with multi-layered architectural defense systems. We provide full visibility and ironclad control over your most sensitive analytical assets.
sovereignty.visualAlt: Digital shield protecting globally connected enterprise data

pillars.title: The Four Pillars of Sovereignty
pillars.subtitle: Our zero-trust architecture ensures that your data remains yours, from the moment of ingestion to the final insight.

mfa.title: MFA Authentication
mfa.text: Identity-first security with biometric and FIDO2 hardware token support across all endpoints.

encryption.title: E2EE Encryption
encryption.text: Military-grade AES-256 standards applied to data both at rest and in active transit.

rbac.title: RBAC Control
rbac.text: Precision attribute-based access control (ABAC) down to the individual cell level.

audit.title: Immutable Audit Logs
audit.text: Tamper-proof, blockchain-verified tracking of every single user and system interaction.
